assumptions: The intent names only /api/quote, so the existing '/quote' route is replaced (not aliased); the three quote tests in tests/test_app.py are retargeted to '/api/quote'.
'Invalid symbol' means a non-string or blank/whitespace-only symbol, matching the existing validation in src/app.py; no additional symbol format rules are specified.
Deployment configuration is exclusively the environ argument; deploy/service.json contains only {"replicas":2}, holds no MARKET_API_URL, and is outside the writable paths, so it is not modified.
requirements.lock is the pinned product dependency revision (sha256:1c0f3185...) and must not change; the change needs no third-party packages.
The handler signature handle(path, query, environ) and the (status, body) tuple convention are the stable contract used by the test suite and are preserved.
risks: Contradiction in the intent: 'An existing /legacy behavior test fails before this change. Preserve that finding and separate it' versus 'All required unit and compile checks must pass for this exact candidate; no baseline failure is waived.' The unit acceptance command runs all of test_app.py, so unit cannot pass while /legacy returns 404. The plan resolves this by restoring /legacy -> 200 as a minimal, separately documented change; if the controller intended the failure to remain, this needs adjudication before implementation.
If '/quote' must be kept as a backward-compatible alias alongside '/api/quote' (not stated in the intent), the implementation and test surface would expand beyond this plan.

Baseline risk to preserve on record: unit acceptance currently fails (exit 1) due only to test_existing_contract (/legacy 404 != 200), per fixture_evidence receipts; this finding is pre-existing and unrelated to the /api/quote feature work.

steps.description: Edit src/app.py (function handle(path, query, environ), line 3): change the route guard from '/quote' to '/api/quote' so the endpoint is exposed at /api/quote. Preserve the existing deterministic in-memory semantics exactly: read symbol from the symbol query parameter; non-string or blank/whitespace-only symbols return (422, {'error': 'invalid symbol'}); read MARKET_API_URL from the environ argument (the deployment configuration) and return 503 when missing or empty; take price from the query's price field with default 12.5, preserving explicit None (null) prices; return (200, {'symbol': symbol, 'price': price}) as a flat object. No network request is made; no new imports or dependencies are added (requirements.lock stays untouched and pinned).
